name: How does AKN Design Group handle utilities coordination during a remodel?

mainEntity.name: How does AKN Design Group handle utilities coordination during a remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group integrates utilities coordination into our comprehensive design-build process from the initial planning stages. This involves assessing your current utility infrastructure, designing new layouts that account for necessary connections, and coordinating with relevant utility providers and local authorities for permits and inspections. Our managed process ensures all utility aspects are considered and approved before construction proceeds, providing a single point of coordination for homeowners.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group integrates utilities coordination from design through permitting and construction, assessing infrastructure and coordinating with providers for a seamless process.
